capabilities: Index vault notes into a knowledge graph
Surface contradictions, gaps and forgotten connections
Queue findings for accept or reject review
Export the graph as JSON-LD or GraphML
Serve the graph to external LLMs over MCP
disambiguation: Not an ontology editor; it builds a knowledge graph from your notes and reports findings for you to accept or reject.
extras: Freemium: the free plan covers one initial indexing, 30 credits per month and the weekly report; extra extraction needs a paid plan bought on the vendor's site, not in the plugin. Browsing the database, export, the weekly report and local MCP work without a hub account. Collecting from folders outside the vault and from Bear is desktop-only.
problem: Large vaults hide notes that contradict each other, concepts that are linked everywhere but never explained, and the same idea written twice, and nothing in Obsidian points these out.

relations.evidence: external AIs such as Claude or GPT connect to your knowledge over MCP
Bring your own endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)
Notes outside Obsidian (plain Markdown folders, Logseq, Bear, OneNote, Evernote, Notion, Google Drive, Dropbox
only Notion takes an internal integration token

requires.name: Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio endpoint

summary: Knowledge-graph plugin that indexes your vault and surfaces contradictions, unexplained concepts and duplicate ideas for you to review.
